function make() {
  const f = () => 1;
  f.tag = "t";
  return f;
}
console.log(make().tag);
const made = make();
console.log(made.tag);

function makeBox() {
  const f = () => 2;
  f.tag = "box";
  return { f };
}
console.log(makeBox().f.tag);

const makeArrow = () => {
  const f = () => 3;
  f.tag = "arrow";
  return f;
};
console.log(makeArrow().tag);

class Factory {
  static make() {
    const f = () => 4;
    f.tag = "static";
    return f;
  }
}
console.log(Factory.make().tag);

function read(g: typeof made) {
  return g.tag;
}
console.log(read(made));

const counter = () => 5;
const alias = counter;
console.log(alias.label);
counter.label = "late";
{
  counter.size = 1;
}
console.log(counter.size, counter["label"]);
